title: FlowDoc Document Structure North Star
summary: Record a bounded product north star for FlowDoc as a document-structure definition system before database relationship design or product implementation continues.
expectedOutput: Document Structure North Star v1 in Project Control, with the product framed as document-structure definition, not a Word or Google Docs style editor, not PDF-only, and with Draft, Version, Publication, component, section, style, page profile, and structure-only database boundaries ready for the next design round.
riskSummary: The north star may be mistaken for product readiness, database implementation, PDF readiness, or FlowDoc product truth. The record explicitly states FlowDoc is not a Word or Google Docs style editor, not PDF-only, and that runtime data, submissions, logs, audit trails, generated files, permissions, Core behavior, Backend behavior, Editor behavior, and map truth remain out of scope.
